leaky_public_view.description: Public evidence also reveals the hidden output at one unobserved input.

drop_last_observation.description: Evidence silently ignores the last public row.

syntactic_identity.description: Hypotheses counted per (support, table) description instead of by extension.

wildcard_missing_key.description: A card with a missing table key is completed with a default output.

ignore_conflicts.description: Contradictory rows are reduced to the first output seen.

statement_trusted_over_keys.description: Card features taken from the statement text without checking the keys.
